summary: V2 Solar Calculator tested end-to-end. Backend /api/solar/resource (Open-Meteo + Zippopotam) works for city, pincode, lat/lon and returns 400/404 correctly. Frontend Calculator: live weather fetch (Jaipur = 354 sunny days, 5.31 kWh/m2/day GHI, 10.3 sun hrs/day), panel-tech/wattage readout updates on selection, O&M inputs reduce net savings, live-vs-state-average toggle changes generation, results page renders all metrics (net-benefit, capacity, cost, EMI, savings, payback) with FinanceDeepDive Term Loan/Lease toggle working, charts rendering without errors. All 6 new backend tests pass.

minor.issue: server.py line 388 references `logger` inside solar_resource() but `logger` is defined at line 415 (after `app.include_router`). If Open-Meteo raises an exception, this will throw NameError instead of the intended 502. Move logger definition above helpers, or import module-level logger earlier.

action_items: Non-blocking: move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the `_fetch_archive` helper so the 502 exception path in /api/solar/resource works if Open-Meteo fails.

Non-blocking: existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still asserts leadId prefix 'EFL-LEAD-' but server generates 'SI-LEAD-' (rebrand). Update or drop those legacy tests — new V2 tests unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: Calculator.jsx is 1060 lines — consider splitting Step components and Results into separate files for maintainability.
`logger` used before defined in server.py solar_resource exception path (NameError risk).
Solar cache TTL check uses fromisoformat without ensuring tz-awareness could mismatch if a legacy naive value is present; current code writes tz-aware ISO so OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 features (live weather, panel tech/wattage, O&M, live-vs-avg toggle, results) all verified working end-to-end on public URL. New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_solar_resource.py has 6 passing tests. Playwright verified: baseline demo -> net ₹2,96,656; AMC=5% -> net ₹1,73,656 (O&M reduces savings correctly); Live vs state-avg toggle changes savings (₹83.94L vs ₹92.30L annual). Term Loan/Lease toggle both render with EMI/rental respectively. Legacy backend_test.py has EFL->SI prefix drift unrelated to V2.
